name: Nofilter.space
mood: austere editorial grid on white paper
summary: A strict monochrome editorial style with Paper White canvas, Ink #333333 text and hairlines, Carbon #000000 emphasis, Pragmatica typography, 0px image/card radius, square bordered featured cards, 3-column grid, checkbox filters, and zero shadows or decorative UI effects.

layout.model: white printed editorial surface with top nav filters, large wordmark, square image cards, bordered featured cards, and strict 3-column alignment

elevation.depth: 1px borders, whitespace, and typographic hierarchy only

dos: Use Paper White as the full page background.
Use Ink #333333 for text, hairlines, borders, and filters.
Use 0px radius for images and cards.
Use a strict 3-column grid with 30px gaps.
Use 1px borders for featured cards and checkbox controls.
Solve hierarchy with size, whitespace, and alignment.
donts: Do not use gradients or blur.
Do not round cards or images.
Do not create SaaS-style CTA buttons.
Do not use decorative dividers when whitespace can separate groups.
